correctness.rationale: The determinant calculation is an exact substitution into the published Montesinos formula. For b >= -1 both linear factors are positive. The first difference is positive, giving injectivity. The factors are coprime odd integers and the second is 2 modulo 3; hence their product is never square. Fox--Milnor then excludes algebraic sliceness and therefore topological sliceness. Finite checks are not used as proof.
